title: Darkest Dungeon: The Board Game
subtitle: Brutal cooperative tactical dungeon crawler confronting cosmic horror, stress, and mortality
tagline: Ruin has come to our family. Steel your resolve against the dark.
loreSummary: You lead a desperate roster of flawed heroes into the cursed ruins beneath your ancestral manor. Survival demands managing not only grievous wounds, but the encroaching madness of the abyss.
keyFeatures: Dynamic stance combat with front, middle, and back row positioning
Psychological stress mechanics: heroes suffer afflictions and virtuous resolves
Hamlet management: heal wounds, cure diseases, and upgrade sanitarium facilities
Punishing rogue-like campaign progression across four escalating difficulty tiers

dd_core.name: Full Manor Campaign (11 Quests)
dd_core.description: The complete 11-quest campaign from Apprentice expeditions to the depths of the Darkest Dungeon and the Ancestor.

dd_intro.name: Apprentice & Veteran Tier (Introductory Run)
dd_intro.description: A shorter introductory campaign through Apprentice and Veteran tiers culminating in the first two major boss confrontations.

dd_grand.name: Grand Estate Purge (Full Campaign + Expansion Content)
dd_grand.description: An expansive multi-region campaign venturing through the Ruins, Weald, Warrens, Cove, and additional boss hunts before braving the Darkest Dungeon.

milestones.title: The Apprentice Incursion
milestones.description: Surviving the initial horrors of the estate and slaying the first Apprentice-tier abomination.

milestones.title: The Veteran Trial
milestones.description: Confronting maddening dread and emerging victorious against the Veteran monstrosity lurking in the catacombs.

milestones.title: The Champion Descent
milestones.description: Pushing battle-scarred heroes to their psychological limits to cleanse the Champion terror.

milestones.title: Heart of the Darkest Dungeon
milestones.description: Breaching the ultimate threshold beneath the manor for the climactic standoff against cosmic corruption.
